knowledge:
- key_parameters: pwm=An instance of class pwm, a matrix, or a data.frame representing the position weight matrix ;; ic.scale=A logical indicating whether the height of each column is proportional to its information content (default is TRUE) ;; fill=A named character vector specifying custom colors for the letters ;; alphabet=Character string specifying the alphabet (e.g., "DNA" or "RNA") in makePWM()
- alternatives: None mentioned
- when_to_use: Use when you want to visualize the conservation and relative frequency of nucleotides at each position of a DNA or RNA sequence motif (such as a transcription factor binding site) using a sequence logo.
- pitfalls: makePWM() strictly requires that all column probabilities in the input matrix add up to exactly 1.0 ;; For RNA logos, seqLogo accepts fill colors specified for c("A", "C", "G", "U") or c("A", "C", "G", "T") and uses the color specified in element "T" for letter "U".

workflows.name: sequence_logo_generation
workflows.intent: Generate and customize sequence logos from a position weight matrix of DNA or RNA sequences.
input: pwm_matrix.txt (a text file containing a position weight matrix where columns represent positions and rows represent nucleotide probabilities summing to 1.0)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and read the position weight matrix from a file ;; 2. Create a PWM object using makePWM() ;; 3. Access PWM slots like information content and consensus sequence ;; 4. Plot the sequence logo using seqLogo(), optionally adjusting information content scaling, colors, or alphabet (DNA/RNA).
workflows.code:
library(seqLogo)
mFile <- system.file("extdata/pwm1", package="seqLogo")
m <- read.table(mFile)
m
p <- makePWM(m)
slotNames(p)
pwm(p)
ic(p)
consensus(p)
seqLogo(p)
seqLogo(p, ic.scale=FALSE)
seqLogo(p, fill=c(A="#4daf4a", C="#377eb8", G="#ffd92f", T="#e41a1c"),
        ic.scale=FALSE)
r <- makePWM(m, alphabet="RNA")
seqLogo(r, ic.scale=FALSE)
